# Presidio Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call


October 27, 2026 8:30am EDT


FORT WORTH, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Presidio Production Company](https://bypresidio.com/) (NYSE: FTW) (“Presidio” or the “Company”) today announced that it will report third quarter 2026 results on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The Company will host an earnings conference call the next morning, Friday, November 13, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET / 9:00 AM CT to discuss financial results and business highlights.


The conference call will be webcast live on the Company’s investor relations website, or can be accessed[HERE](https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1780999&tp_key=4771fcfd00) .


To access the call, please use the following information:


**Date:**


Friday, November 13, 2026


**Time:**


10:00 AM ET / 9:00 AM CT


**Dial-in:**


1-877-407-0779


**International Dial-in:**


1-201-389-0914


**Conference Code:**


13763581


**Webcast:**


Please click[here](https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1780999&tp_key=4771fcfd00) to register.


The earnings call will also be archived on Presidio’s investor relations website. A replay will be available shortly after the call and can be accessed by dialing 1-844-512-2921, or for international callers, 1-412-317-6671. The passcode for the replay is 13763581 and will be available through November 27, 2026.


The webcast replay can also be viewed[here](https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1780999&tp_key=4771fcfd00) and the presentation utilized during the call will be available in the Company’s investor relations section[here](https://ir.bypresidio.com/) .


**About Presidio Production Company**


Headquartered in Fort Worth, TX, Presidio Production Company (NYSE: FTW) is a yield-focused, differentiated oil and gas operator in the United States focused on the acquisition and optimization of producing oil and natural gas wells, without drilling. Presidio applies engineering expertise and AI-driven analytics to enhance performance and extend asset life. The Company’s Class A common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “FTW”. To learn more, visit[https://bypresidio.com/](https://bypresidio.com/) .
